entries.message: <{tag}> was defined before @verajs/hot was wired, so its registration is the real class and cannot be redefined.
entries.fix: Wire hot first in the entry, before any component module defines a tag.

entries.message: was wired where core's `customElements.define` wrapper is not installed, so a swap would replace core's lifecycle callbacks instead of running inside them.
entries.fix: Import `@verajs/core` before wiring, and wire hot through core's `wire`: `wire([renderer, hot])`.

entries.message: <{tag}> changed in a way a live element cannot take ({reason}), so a reload was requested.
entries.fix: Cancel the `vera-hot-reload` event on the window to handle it yourself (a preview frame, for instance).
